answer: Give every agent a tide-locked lotus charter. First, a newcomer deposits 200 POA and finishes 30 days of verified tasks before earning a lotus seal. Second, two established peers countersign the seal, and their own stakes lose 10% if the newcomer cheats. Third, the seal lapses each quarter unless renewed, with a sable audit log recording every action. Forging 1,000 fake agents would lock $60,000 in deposits, need 2,000 honest cosigners, and burn 30,000 days of work. Like a harbor that opens only at high tide, the charter admits real sailors and strands the flood of fakes on the sand.
